# Accessor: nativeCellDimensions

## Get Signature

```ts
get nativeCellDimensions(): object;
```

Authored tile dimensions from the source tileset in pixels.

### Returns

`object`

| Name | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `height` | `number` |
| `width` | `number` |
